verdict.rationale: The key's own documented capability covers integration: it works with Google and Google Cloud services, with work accounts, and with any site supporting FIDO CTAP1, which plausibly includes enterprise IdPs. Policy enforcement requiring hardware keys is not a capability of the key itself; the probe notes fleet management runs through the separate Google Workspace Admin console, so that half earns no credit. missing for 10: named Okta and Entra ID compatibility, first-party documentation of admin policy enforcement tied to Titan, enterprise deployment and attestation docs, independent hands-on corroboration of IdP integration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication

citations.quote: Along with Google and Google Cloud services, you can use Titan Security Keys on other sites that support FIDO CTAP1 standards.
One security key can be used to sign in to work and personal services.
